data.name: Amira
data.gender_notes: Amira is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r), 'to command'. Amīra is the feminine of amīr, 'prince, commander'. Its root is أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r). A common Arabic female name. Amira is a Arabic name meaning “Princess; commander; leader”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amira expresses “Princess; commander; leader”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r), 'to command'. Amīra is the feminine of amīr, 'prince, commander'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amira total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
